         * Определить категорию по названию локации.
         * Ищет строку scoreboard, содержащую название локации.
         */
        fun fromLocation(locationName: String): LocationMusicCategory? {
            val clean = locationName.lowercase().trim()
            for (category in entries) {
                for (loc in category.locations) {
                    if (clean.contains(loc.lowercase())) {
                        return category
                    }
                }
            }
            return null
        }
    }
}

    ETHEREAL,   // Загадочная - полупрозрачные, парящие
    SOCIAL      // Хаб - нейтральные, упорядоченные
}

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"src/main/kotlin/set/starlev/features/music/LocationMusicEngine.kt","content":"package set.starlev.features.music

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft
import net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SimpleSoundInstance
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents
import set.starlev.StarredHeltix
import set.starlev.config.categories.MusicConfig
import set.starlev.utils.detectors.LocationDetector
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.random.Random

/**
 * Движок музыки по локациям.
 * Воспроизводит мелодии через нотные блоки напрямую через SoundManager.
 */
object LocationMusicEngine {

    private val mc = Minecraft.getInstance()
    private val random = Random(System.currentTimeMillis())

    // Состояние
    private var currentCategory: LocationMusicCategory? = null
    private var targetCategory: LocationMusicCategory? = null
    private var isPlaying = false
    private var isTransitioning = false

    // Таймеры
    private var lastLocationCheck = 0L
    private var transitionStartTime = 0L
    private var lastNoteTime = 0L

    // Стабилизация локации
    private var pendingCategory: LocationMusicCategory? = null
    private var pendingCategoryCount = 0

    // Позиция в мелодии
    private var currentSectionIndex = 0
    private var melodyIndex = 0
    private var harmonyIndex = 0
    private var rhythmIndex = 0
    private var ticksUntilNextNote = 2
    private var sectionChangeCounter = 0
    private val sectionChangeThreshold = 72

    // Громкость
    private var currentVolume = 0f
    private var targetVolume = 0f
    private var transitionStartVolume = 0f

    // Мелодическая память
    private var lastNoteIndex = -1
    private var lastTwoNotes = listOf(-1, -1)
    private var phrasePosition = 0
    private val phraseLength = 24

    // Вариативность
    private var currentRhythmPatternIndex = 0
    private var variationSeed = 0L

    // Басовая линия
    private var bassNoteIndex = 0
    private var lastBassNote = -1

    fun init() {
        net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.event.lifecycle.v1.ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register { client ->
            val config = StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic
            if (!config.enabled) {
                if (isPlaying) stopMusic()
                return@register
            }

            if (client.player == null || client.level == null) return@register

            updateLocation()
            updateMusic()
        }
    }

    private fun updateLocation() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastLocationCheck < 500) return
        lastLocationCheck = now

        val locationName = LocationDetector.getCurrentLocationClean()
        if (locationName == null) {
            pendingCategory = null
            pendingCategoryCount = 0
            return
        }

        val newCategory = LocationMusicCategory.fromLocation(locationName)
        if (newCategory == null) {
            pendingCategory = null
            pendingCategoryCount = 0
            return
        }

        if (newCategory == pendingCategory) {
            pendingCategoryCount++
        } else {
            pendingCategory = newCategory
            pendingCategoryCount = 1
        }

        if (pendingCategoryCount >= 2 && newCategory != currentCategory) {
            StarredHeltix.LOGGER.info("[MusicEngine] Смена: ${currentCategory?.displayName ?: "нет"} -> ${newCategory.displayName} ('$locationName')")
            switchCategory(newCategory)
            pendingCategory = null
            pendingCategoryCount = 0
        }
    }

    private fun switchCategory(newCategory: LocationMusicCategory) {
        val config = StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic

        val categoryConfig = getCategoryConfig(newCategory)
        if (categoryConfig != null && !categoryConfig.enabled) {
            if (isPlaying) stopMusic()
            return
        }

        if (currentCategory == null) {
            targetCategory = newCategory
            currentCategory = newCategory
            resetMelody()
            currentVolume = config.volume / 100f
            targetVolume = currentVolume
            isPlaying = true
            isTransitioning = false
            StarredHeltix.LOGGER.info("[MusicEngine] ▶ Музыка запущена: ${newCategory.displayName}")
        } else if (newCategory != currentCategory) {
            startTransition(newCategory)
        }
    }

    private fun startTransition(newCategory: LocationMusicCategory?) {
        if (isTransitioning && targetCategory == newCategory) return

        isTransitioning = true
        transitionStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        transitionStartVolume = currentVolume
        targetCategory = newCategory

        if (newCategory == null) {
            isPlaying = false
        }
    }

    private fun updateMusic() {
        val config = StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()

        if (isTransitioning) {
            val elapsed = (now - transitionStartTime) / 1000f
            val fadeDuration = config.fadeDuration

            if (elapsed >= fadeDuration) {
                isTransitioning = false
                if (targetCategory != null) {
                    currentCategory = targetCategory
                    resetMelody()
                    currentVolume = config.volume / 100f
                    targetVolume = currentVolume
                    isPlaying = true
                    StarredHeltix.LOGGER.info("[MusicEngine] ▶ Переход завершён: ${currentCategory!!.displayName}")
                } else {
                    isPlaying = false
                    currentVolume = 0f
                    return
                }
            } else {
                currentVolume = transitionStartVolume * (1f - elapsed / fadeDuration)
            }
            return
        }

        if (!isPlaying || currentCategory == null) return

        val fadeSpeed = 0.05f
        if (currentVolume < targetVolume) {
            currentVolume = minOf(currentVolume + fadeSpeed, targetVolume)
        } else if (currentVolume > targetVolume) {
            currentVolume = maxOf(currentVolume - fadeSpeed, targetVolume)
        }

        if (currentVolume <= 0.01f) return

        val categoryConfig = getCategoryConfig(currentCategory!!)
        val tempo = categoryConfig?.tempo ?: 100
        val intensity = categoryConfig?.intensity ?: 0.5f
        val beatInterval = 60000L / tempo

        if (now - lastNoteTime >= beatInterval * ticksUntilNextNote) {
            playNote(currentCategory!!, intensity)
            lastNoteTime = now

            val section = currentCategory!!.sections[currentSectionIndex]
            val rhythm = currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns[currentSectionIndex % currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns.size]
            rhythmIndex = (rhythmIndex + 1) % rhythm.size
            ticksUntilNextNote = rhythm[rhythmIndex]

            phrasePosition = (phrasePosition + 1) % phraseLength
            melodyIndex = (melodyIndex + 1) % section.baseNotes.size
            sectionChangeCounter++

            if (sectionChangeCounter >= sectionChangeThreshold) {
                sectionChangeCounter = 0
                currentSectionIndex = (currentSectionIndex + 1) % currentCategory!!.sections.size
                currentRhythmPatternIndex = (currentRhythmPatternIndex + 1) % currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns.size
                melodyIndex = 0
                harmonyIndex = 0
                phrasePosition = 0
                bassNoteIndex = 0
                variationSeed = System.currentTimeMillis()
                StarredHeltix.LOGGER.info("[MusicEngine] Смена секции: $currentSectionIndex для ${currentCategory!!.displayName}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun playNote(category: LocationMusicCategory, intensity: Float) {
        val player = mc.player ?: return
        val section = category.sections[currentSectionIndex]
        val baseNotes = section.baseNotes
        val harmonyNotes = section.harmonyNotes

        // Мелодия - умный выбор ноты
        var noteIndex = melodyIndex % baseNotes.size
        if (noteIndex == lastNoteIndex) {
            val offset = if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else -1
            noteIndex = ((noteIndex + offset) % baseNotes.size + baseNotes.size) % baseNotes.size
        }
        if (lastTwoNotes.size >= 2 &&
            baseNotes[noteIndex] == lastTwoNotes[0] &&
            baseNotes[noteIndex] == lastTwoNotes[1]) {
            noteIndex = (noteIndex + 2) % baseNotes.size
        }
        lastNoteIndex = noteIndex
        lastTwoNotes = listOf(baseNotes[noteIndex]) + lastTwoNotes.take(1)

        val midiNote = baseNotes[noteIndex]
        val pitch = midiToPitch(midiNote)
        val volumeVariation = 0.75f + random.nextFloat() * 0.25f
        val volume = currentVolume * intensity * volumeVariation

        // Случайные паузы для естественности
        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.08f && intensity < 0.7f) return

        if (volume > 0.01f) {
            val instrument = selectInstrument(category, phrasePosition)
            val sound = instrument.sound

            mc.soundManager.play(
                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, volume, pitch)
            )

            // Басовая линия - играет каждые 4 ноты
            if (phrasePosition % 4 == 0) {
                val bassNotes = listOf(36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 48, 50)
                val bassMidi = bassNotes[bassNoteIndex % bassNotes.size]
                val bassPitch = midiToPitch(bassMidi)
                val bassVolume = volume * 0.5f

                mc.soundManager.play(
                    SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value(), bassVolume, bassPitch)
                )
                bassNoteIndex++
            }

            // Гармония - терция или квинта
            if (intensity > 0.3f && phrasePosition % 2 == 0) {
                val harmIndex = harmonyIndex % harmonyNotes.size
                val harmNote = harmonyNotes[harmIndex]
                val harmPitch = midiToPitch(harmNote)
                harmonyIndex = (harmonyIndex + 1) % harmonyNotes.size

                val harmVolume = volume * 0.3f * (0.7f + random.nextFloat() * 0.3f)
                mc.soundManager.play(
                    SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, harmVolume, harmPitch)
                )
            }

            // Аккорд при высокой интенсивности
            if (intensity > 0.6f && phrasePosition % 8 == 0) {
                val chordIndex = (harmonyIndex + 3) % harmonyNotes.size
                val chordNote = harmonyNotes[chordIndex]
                val chordPitch = midiToPitch(chordNote)
                val chordVolume = volume * 0.25f

                mc.soundManager.play(
                    SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, chordVolume, chordPitch)
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun selectInstrument(category: LocationMusicCategory, phrasePos: Int): Instrument {
        return when (category.atmosphere) {
            AtmosphereType.INTENSE -> when (phrasePos % 12) {
                0, 1 -> Instrument.BASS
                2, 3 -> Instrument.BASEDRUM
                4 -> Instrument.SNARE
                5 -> Instrument.PLING
                6 -> Instrument.ZOMBIE
                7 -> Instrument.CREEPER
                8 -> Instrument.BASS
                9 -> Instrument.WITHER_SKELETON
                10 -> Instrument.SNARE
                else -> Instrument.BASEDRUM
            }
            AtmosphereType.CALM -> when (phrasePos % 10) {
                0 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                1 -> Instrument.HARP
                2 -> Instrument.BANJO
                3 -> Instrument.BELL
                4 -> Instrument.HARP
                5 -> Instrument.GUITAR
                6 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                7 -> Instrument.BANJO
                8 -> Instrument.HARP
                else -> Instrument.GUITAR
            }
            AtmosphereType.NATURE -> when (phrasePos % 12) {
                0 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                1 -> Instrument.HARP
                2 -> Instrument.BELL
                3 -> Instrument.BANJO
                4 -> Instrument.CHIME
                5 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                6 -> Instrument.GUITAR
                7 -> Instrument.HARP
                8 -> Instrument.DIDGERIDOO
                9 -> Instrument.CHIME
                10 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                else -> Instrument.BELL
            }
            AtmosphereType.DEEP -> when (phrasePos % 12) {
                0, 1 -> Instrument.BASS
                2 -> Instrument.BASEDRUM
                3 -> Instrument.BIT
                4 -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
                5 -> Instrument.CHIME
                6 -> Instrument.BASS
                7 -> Instrument.DIDGERIDOO
                8 -> Instrument.XYLOPHONE
                9 -> Instrument.BASEDRUM
                10 -> Instrument.BIT
                else -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
            }
            AtmosphereType.MYSTIC -> when (phrasePos % 12) {
                0 -> Instrument.CHIME
                1 -> Instrument.BELL
                2 -> Instrument.DRAGON
                3 -> Instrument.PLING
                4 -> Instrument.CHIME
                5 -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
                6 -> Instrument.BELL
                7 -> Instrument.DRAGON
                8 -> Instrument.CHIME
                9 -> Instrument.PLING
                10 -> Instrument.BELL
                else -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
            }
            AtmosphereType.ETHEREAL -> when (phrasePos % 10) {
                0 -> Instrument.BELL
                1 -> Instrument.CHIME
                2 -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
                3 -> Instrument.BELL
                4 -> Instrument.CHIME
                5 -> Instrument.DIDGERIDOO
                6 -> Instrument.BELL
                7 -> Instrument.CHIME
                8 -> Instrument.IRON_XYLOPHONE
                else -> Instrument.BELL
            }
            AtmosphereType.SOCIAL -> when (phrasePos % 10) {
                0 -> Instrument.HARP
                1 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                2 -> Instrument.GUITAR
                3 -> Instrument.BELL
                4 -> Instrument.HARP
                5 -> Instrument.BANJO
                6 -> Instrument.FLUTE
                7 -> Instrument.GUITAR
                8 -> Instrument.HARP
                else -> Instrument.BELL
            }
        }
    }

    private fun midiToPitch(midiNote: Int): Float {
        return 2.0f.pow((midiNote - 57) / 12.0f)
    }

    private fun getCategoryConfig(category: LocationMusicCategory): MusicConfig.LocationMusicConfig.LocationMusicEntryConfig? {
        return when (category) {
            LocationMusicCategory.COMBAT -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.combat
            LocationMusicCategory.FARMING -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.farming
            LocationMusicCategory.FORAGING -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.foraging
            LocationMusicCategory.MINING -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.mining
            LocationMusicCategory.ENDER -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.ender
            LocationMusicCategory.MYSTERIOUS -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.mysterious
            LocationMusicCategory.HUB -> StarredHeltix.feature.music.locationMusic.hub
        }
    }

    private fun resetMelody() {
        currentSectionIndex = 0
        melodyIndex = 0
        harmonyIndex = 0
        rhythmIndex = 0
        ticksUntilNextNote = 2
        sectionChangeCounter = 0
        phrasePosition = 0
        lastNoteIndex = -1
        lastTwoNotes = listOf(-1, -1)
        currentRhythmPatternIndex = 0
        variationSeed = System.currentTimeMillis()
        bassNoteIndex = 0
        lastBassNote = -1
    }

    private fun stopMusic() {
        if (isPlaying) startTransition(null)
    }

    fun getCurrentCategory(): LocationMusicCategory? = currentCategory
    fun isMusicPlaying(): Boolean = isPlaying && currentVolume > 0.01f
    fun getCurrentVolume(): Float = currentVolume

    private enum class Instrument(val sound: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent) {
        HARP(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_HARP.value()),
        BASS(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value()),
        BELL(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BELL.value()),
        FLUTE(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_FLUTE.value()),
        CHIME(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_CHIME.value()),
        PLING(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_PLING.value()),
        GUITAR(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_GUITAR.value()),
        BASEDRUM(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASEDRUM.value()),
        SNARE(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_SNARE.value()),
        HAT(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_HAT.value()),
        XYLOPHONE(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_XYLOPHONE.value()),
        IRON_XYLOPHONE(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IRON_XYLOPHONE.value()),
        COW_BELL(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_COW_BELL.value()),
        DIDGERIDOO(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_DIDGERIDOO.value()),
        BIT(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BIT.value()),
        BANJO(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BANJO.value()),
        ZOMBIE(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_ZOMBIE.value()),
        SKELETON(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_SKELETON.value()),
        CREEPER(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_CREEPER.value()),
        DRAGON(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_ENDER_DRAGON.value()),
        WITHER_SKELETON(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_WITHER_SKELETON.value()),
        PIGLIN(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_IMITATE_PIGLIN.value())
    }
}
